title: Nice sponge holders, but mine didn't stick
text: Nice sponge holders, but mine didn't stick. I really like these sponge holders. They are nicely made and just the right size to keep sponges or scouring pads handy and dry on the sink's backsplash. Unfortunately, the included adhesive didn't work on the smooth ceramic tile in my kitchen. I ordered more powerful two-sided adhesive strips here on Amazon and since then they have stayed up fine and are very handy. Bottom line--I like the little fixtures, but if you buy them, order more powerful adhesive strips.
